scope: Main-continuous-only audit; source values are preserved and no data is corrected.

alignment.edb_raw: 1m timestamp is bar start in Asia/Shanghai; convert datetime_nano to UTC+08:00.
alignment.edb_aggregates: 5m and 60m end-label; use trading-minute clock, skip intraday breaks; day 60m ends 10:00,11:15,14:15,15:00; final daytime bar has 45 trading minutes. Night ends 22:00,23:00.
alignment.sina: M0 samples are retained as an independent continuous-contract reference; no specific-contract comparison is included.
alignment.complete_meaning: Complete means all constituent minute records present and finite; it does not guarantee source prices are correct or every trading session is present.

main_continuous.independent_raw_to_5m_and_60m_recalculat: Previously independently looped every wall-clock minute in every saved bar interval against raw 1m dict; zero OHLCV mismatches for both periods.
